overview_description.description: Tough Commerce (formerly Brokrete) platform allows suppliers to publish their branded app or web storefront to bring their operations online. It encompasses order management, payouts, dispatching logistics, and real-time delivery. With financial & operational ERP integrations, the Tough Commerce platform can operate stand-alone or seamlessly alongside deeply integrated products.

about_short_description.short_description: Tough Commerce builds white-label order management and e-commerce tools for construction suppliers.

product.name: All-in-One Job Management Software
product.description: A cloud-based platform for asset-based construction businesses to manage job scheduling, operator tracking, invoicing, and analytics in one system.

product.name: Contractor App (White-label Customer Portal)
product.description: A branded mobile app allowing contractors to place orders, view tickets and invoices, and receive real-time updates independently.

product.name: Dispatch and Scheduling System
product.description: A scheduling and dispatch tool tailored for construction industries to manage orders, operators, and assets with drag-and-drop functionality.

identifier.value: Delivery Solutions (Driver App and Logistics Suite)

product.name: Delivery Solutions (Driver App and Logistics Suite)
product.description: A driver-focused app and logistics tools for managing deliveries, tracking routes, and capturing proof of delivery digitally.

product.name: Finance and Back-Office Automation Suite
product.description: A set of tools automating invoicing, e-ticketing, accounts receivable, payments, credit management, and sales tax compliance.

product.name: Payment Solutions
product.description: A payment processing system supporting credit cards, ACH, POS, credit terms, and flexible payment options integrated across the platform.
